# Event-level metrics (generated by step 8)

All metrics use usable test windows only (206,857 windows, 184.0 calendar days). Thresholds were fitted on calib and frozen before each model scored test. Alerts outside reported windows are **unconfirmed alerts**, not false alarms. Detection range = [start - 24 h, end]; delay = first alert time in that range minus window start (negative = before the reported start). With only four reported events these results are exploratory.

**How to read detection.** The four detection ranges ([start - 24 h, end]) together cover 7.6 of the 184.0 test days (4.2%). A model that flags a large share of all windows will overlap these ranges by chance, so 'events detected' must be read together with 'alert_window_fraction' and 'unconfirmed_alerts_per_day'. A delay near -24 h means an alert event was already running when the lead range began (the delay is clipped to the range start), not that the failure was anticipated.
